When is the best time to go on a cruise in Ha Long, is the question that most of you are interested in, especially those who want to experience on luxury cruises to see the scenery, or soak in the cool water from the cruise, enjoy Asian and European dishes will bring you the most interesting vacation.

To have the most beautiful cruise in Ha Long, tourists should travel to Ha Long from April to October, when the weather is cool and clear, very favorable for tourists’ sightseeing or sightseeing.

Accompanying Vietlook to experience Ha Long cruise, tourists will have a wonderful adventure on the bay, when the boat glides past the famous sights, tourists can admire, or enjoy soaking in the swimming pool, enjoying delicious dishes right on the cruise will be a great experience when going on a cruise in Ha Long.

The weather in the bay has 4 distinct seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Traveling to Ha Long from April to September, the weather is hot and sunny, in August there are occasional sudden showers, but the short rains do not affect the tourists’ sightseeing journey.

The best time to go on a cruise in Ha Long is in the spring or fall, the weather in Ha Long from April to October is relatively favorable for tourists to have a trip on the sea.

Traveling to Ha Long Bay in the summer, tourists can also experience interesting sea games such as swimming, kayaking, snorkeling, volleyball, which will bring tourists the most perfect vacation.

In addition, when experiencing a cruise overnight, tourists can also admire the moonlight on the sea, a beautiful scene with clear blue water. However, if traveling to Ha Long in the rainy season, tourists should check the weather before coming here so as not to affect their sightseeing itinerary.

Therefore, you can go on a cruise in Ha Long all year round, although no matter what time you choose, Ha Long will bring you a wonderful experience, you should make a plan for your sightseeing tour to be the most perfect.

Experiencing on luxury cruises in Ha Long will bring you different emotions, and participating in games such as: many emotions and exciting experiences such as: kayaking, night squid fishing with coastal fishermen will bring you the most unforgettable moments.

Especially watching the sunset from a cruise with friends and relatives is nothing more interesting, so if you are planning to go on a cruise in Ha Long this summer, come with Vietlook Travel to Ha Long today to experience on 5-star cruises.

Experience on a cruise in Ha Long

Determine the time of departure, proactively book a room 1 or 2 weeks in advance. Especially during holidays, you should proactively book as soon as possible.

If you book a 5-star cruise, there will be full amenities such as an outdoor swimming pool, massage services and enjoy delicious dishes right on the cruise.

The Ha Long cruise will take you through the scenic spots of Sung Sot Cave, Titop Island, Luon Cave, Bai Tu Long Bay or attractions such as Vung Vieng Fishing Village, Soi Sim Island, Thien Canh Son Cave. In addition, you can choose Lan Ha Bay through the scenic spots of Sang Toi Cave, Ba Trai Dao Island, Quan Y Cave, Viet Hai Fishing Village…

In addition, when you have enjoyed the sightseeing, you should enjoy delicious dishes, or you can choose fresh seafood dishes such as: Shrimp, squid, crab, clams, mantis shrimp…

When choosing a menu with main dishes and desserts, each menu will bring diners the most perfect experience, with a combination of flavor and quality of food, the dishes are also decorated very eye-catching by talented chefs.

If you want to experience a romantic space on a cruise, you should choose a BBQ party on the sundeck in the morning on the top floor of the cruise, enjoy the fresh air on the sea, and listen to the music.

The BBQ party includes meats such as beef tenderloin, pork, chicken, and seafood such as shrimp, squid, fish, and vegetables mixed together to bring diners a delicious and famous flavor.

In the rooms on the yacht are decorated very eye-catching, you will have private space and enjoy delicious dishes by talented chefs that will bring you the most memorable vacation.
